description: Compensates each of the two selected emitted links of one entangled-photon source once from factory tomography states and publishes their installed absolute compensation tables without post-installation verification, acceptance thresholds or automatic repetition; COMPLETED denotes operational completion, not certified polarization quality. An explicit latchGuard policy is applied to every acquired window; required includes the network-resolved detector-health devices in the declared resource union.

deviceId.description: Entangled-photon source whose two emitted links are compensated.

linkIds.description: Exactly two distinct source-emitted analyzer-equipped links to compensate as one source campaign.

items.description: One emitted link identifier belonging to deviceId.

resourceDeviceIds.description: Exact source-campaign lease union: source, every source inline attenuator that carrier changes may write, each resolved analyzer, and each resolved TimeTagger.

items.description: One unique device identifier in the source-campaign lease union.

probeAttenuation.description: Total H/D probe attenuation request forwarded unchanged to each composed link campaign in ConfigureQuantumLinkCarrier form. Use perLink to specify the source's two emitted links independently.

mode.description: Carrier attenuation mode for H/D probes.

commonDb.description: Total attenuation on every emitted source link when mode is common.

perLinkDb.description: Total attenuation by emitted source link when mode is perLink.

measurementDurationSec.description: Finite duration of every singles window used by each link campaign, in seconds.

settleSec.description: Delay after carrier and analyzer-state changes and before the following finite measurement window, in seconds. The default preserves a one-second physical settling interval for analyzer rotations.

minTotalCounts.description: Minimum total background-corrected tomography counts required independently for every H and D probe observation.

persist.description: Persist each installed analyzer compensation table on its owning DeviceOS host by default; set false for nonpersistent installations. Persistence does not imply a physical acceptance gate.

latchGuard.description: Explicit finite-window latch policy propagated to background and tomography acquisitions. required rejects invalid windows and retries only after detector recovery; disabled deliberately acquires without latch protection.

mode.description: Whether per-window detector-latch validation is disabled or required.

maxWindowRetries.description: Maximum immediate retries of an invalid window after a recovered latch.

link.polarizationCompensation.plan.sourc.description: Resolved source/link roles and resources with explicit probeTraffic.

link.polarizationCompensation.observatio.description: Background, H/D counts, raw child observations and latch evidence indexed by estimated link; no invented reference observation.

link.polarizationCompensation.estimate.c.description: H/D compensation estimates indexed only by estimated link.

link.polarizationCompensation.applied.li.description: Confirmed table installations with link identity and target/reference role; partial successful writes are retained.

link.polarizationCompensation.applied.re.description: Confirmed reference-only factory-equivalent table reset, or null when not performed.

link.polarizationCompensation.status.cam.description: Operational outcome, failures, child identities and final analyzer state; completion does not certify polarization quality.

link.polarizationCompensation.status.car.description: Exact source/ATT snapshot restoration evidence, including partial or unknown outcomes.

link.polarizationCompensation.artifact.s.description: Detailed common JSON campaign report, or null if writing failed.
Common Markdown summary, or null if writing failed.
